Page 16 Cont.
Nov. 16 Sacred Heart School wins. L. contest
18 Specialist Monery visited him from
19 Rev. Fr: Ivo arrived Here to supply labor of Fr. Bruno till latters recovery.
20 Official announcement of Sacred Heart School victory for Library - contest - surpassed only by elks. A landslide above all expectations. Over a million votes ahead of any other school in Yonkers. 4,623,883 gave the $800.00 Library to our jubilant boys and girls.
Nov. 21 Presentation B.V.M. in Temple Rev. . F Fr. Fidelis, Justin and Kiniry visited us Today.
Nov. 24 Sunday Visitor came 1st time.
Nov. 28 Thanksgiving Day. Br. James nameday. V. Rev. Ex prov. Fr. Antonine, Fr. Fidelis, Fr. Justin and others visited Yonkers.A wedding at the 6 o clock Mass and another at 4 P.M. with first snow of the season and other events made it quite a memorable Thanksgiving - (eneven where there was no turkey
Dec. 1st Advent began
Dec. 8th Feast of the Immaculate Conception. Nearly 1000 holy Communions To-day.
Dec. 17 Retreat for Holy Name Society - Concluded Sunday Dec. 22nd (6 new members received)
Dec. 20 Alfred Dempsey, Tho's Fagan & Edw'd Bly accompanied Fr. Sol. to N.Y. City to get new cassocks for students, etc. They enjoyed the trip. Had dinner at St. Fid. Monastery.
24th 1st real Snow storm.
Dec. 25 Feast of Nativity - a happy day for the altar boys - and for all the Parish - though very busy for the former. All received Holy Com. a few of the boys served as much 5 five times. They enjoyed the privilege but seemed tired-
